run_mintox_pipeline: run the MinTox pipeline to mitigate added toxicity in model-generated text or unit outputs at inference time
extract_bad_words_with_batch_indices: extract bad words from source and target texts and return them with their batch indices
replace_with_new_text_output_in_batch: replace toxic text outputs in a batch with cleaned versions at specified indices
replace_with_new_unit_output_in_batch: replace toxic unit token outputs in a batch with cleaned versions at specified indices
create_banned_sequence_processor: create a banned sequence processor that blocks toxic words and their punctuation-prefixed variants during text generation
